title: Direct database access from the SDK (restricted pattern)
summary: The SDK template contains ZnodeDomainService, which uses entity and stored-procedure repositories. This is direct data access, not an API call. CONFLICT: the KB's API Customization Guide states there is no direct database or Entity Framework access from the Custom API; the template nevertheless contains this code. Treat direct data access as NOT SUPPORTED unless Znode confirms otherwise.
when_to_use: only for tables the customer owns (custom data models in Custom.Libraries.Data)
not_for: reading or writing Znode core tables: use the Znode APIs, which enforce business rules, caching and tenancy

docs.title: API Customization Guide (states: no direct database or Entity Framework access)

limitations: Bypasses Znode caching and publish behaviour
May break on upgrade when core schema changes
Documented as not available (KB) while present in the template: confidence capped at 60% until Znode settles it; do not propose it for Znode data, and ask before using it for customer-owned data
